notes.title: Stable build | New 33 Wallpapers | 6 languages (PC,Mac & Linux)
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

New updated build has
* All know bugs fixed. Auto bug reporting system.
* New 33 wallpapers uploaded.
* English/ French/ German / Spanish/ Portuguese/ Italian builds in 3 platforms (PC/Mac & Linux) 


Additionally Darkarta Upgrade DLC provides 29 fresh concepts and 55 new wallpapers
https://store.steampowered.com/app/699200/Darkarta__Collector_Edition_Upgrade_DLC/


Darkarta Awaits you...
Happy gaming!
Team tuttifrutti

notes.title: Standard to Collector's Edition Upgrade DLC
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30457029/e2fa495e199e49e715acd64ee4104bafa16d7a39.png
Darkarta Standard to Collector's Edition Upgrade DLC is launched.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/699200/

Upgrade provides collector's Edition special features
-----------------------------------------
* Bonus Chapter “Rising of the Phoenix”– Play in 'god' mode.
* 30 Nostalgic memory collectibles
* 36 Hall of Fame Medals
* 28 Morphing Objects
* Concepts, Wallpapers and Sound tracks 
* Steam Achievements/Replay Mini Games/HOP/Cut-scenes

And 40% JUMBO discount "just" for this opening week to support all Standard Edition customers who supported us in the past, 


Happy gaming!
Sincerely
Tuttifrutti Crew

notes.title: Major update (Remastered Edition)
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/fdecef8a67bd7b98a3e8619bf91304a9ef18a552.jpg
Sorry for the long delay. Appreciate your patience & kind hearty support all these days. 

We are back with a major stable update!

* Stable build! No more crashes! (All reported crashes till date fixed)
* 10$ Music tracks & wallpapers free - Can be saved now to document folder.
* Better Fonts. 
* Supports more display modes
* Dozens of minor fine tuning. :Loved:
* Game Pricing is changed (CE 9.99$, SE $5.99) to match with Bigfish portal pricing where it is all time top-rated. 

Happy gaming!! 

And if you like Darkarta, please do share your reviews at  
http://store.steampowered.com/recommended/recommendgame/601530


as that can help us create better games tomorrow! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28052735/fa4fbc80546fa6e9ccec2e7a615727362b0ed2dd.jpg

Looking forward to hear back from you all soon!
Sincerely
Tuttifrutti Crew

notes.title: Standard Vs Collector's Edition
notes.content:
Standard Edition features
-------------------------------
* A mother's epic frantic quest for her daughter, to the lost civilization of the Indus Valley - An untold saga of true love.
* Explore ‘unforeseen’ environs and original puzzles. 7 Chapters
* Prequel Comic Book, Mom's diary pages
* Steam Achievements/ Inventory Items/ Badges/ Chat Emoticons/ Profile Backgrounds


Collector's Edition special features
-----------------------------------------
* Bonus Chapter “Rising of the Phoenix”– Play in 'god' mode.
* 30 Nostalgic memory collectibles
* 36 Hall of Fame Medals
* 28 Morphing Objects
* Concepts, Wallpapers and Sound tracks 
* Replay Mini Games/HOP/Cut-scenes
